35748.grammar: pr, from na pasaṃsati, neg, trans (+acc)
35748.meaning1: does not praise; does not approve (of); does not commend
35748.construction:
na + pa + saṃsa + ti
na + pasaṃsati

examples.text: na ve kadariyā devalokaṃ vajanti, bālā have nappasaṃsanti dānaṃ, dhīro ca dānaṃ anumodamāno, ten'eva so hoti sukhī parattha.

35749.grammar: pr, from na pasīdati, neg, intrans
35749.construction:
na + pa + sīda + ti
na + pasīdati

examples.text: tattha jhāyī ca bhikkhū nappasīdanti, dhammayogā ca bhikkhū nappasīdanti, na ca bahujanahitāya paṭipannā honti bahujanasukhāya bahuno janassa atthāya hitāya sukhāya devamanussānaṃ
ko sutvā nappasīdeyya, api kaṇh'ābhijātiyo, tasmā hi attakāmena, mahattam'abhikaṅkhatā, saddhammo garukātabbo, saraṃ buddhāna'sāsanan'ti.

35750.grammar: pr, from na pavattati, neg, intrans
35750.meaning1: does not happen; no longer occurs; does not exist
35750.construction:
na + pa + vatta + ti
na + pavattati

examples.text: chadhāturo ayaṃ, bhikkhu, puriso chaphass'āyatano aṭṭhārasamano'pavicāro catur'ādhiṭṭhāno, yattha ṭhitaṃ maññ'assavā nappavattanti, maññ'assave kho pana nappavattamāne muni santo'ti vuccati.

35751.grammar: prp of na pavattati, neg, intrans
35751.meaning1: not existing; not happening; not taking place; not continuing

examples.text: chadhāturo ayaṃ, bhikkhu, puriso chaphass'āyatano aṭṭhārasamano'pavicāro catur'ādhiṭṭhāno, yattha ṭhitaṃ maññ'assavā nappavattanti, maññ'assave kho pana nappavattamāne muni santo'ti vuccati.

35752.meaning1: not going on; not occurring; not manifesting

examples.text: ye ca me, bhante, dhammā pubbe manussabhūtassa pavattino ahesuṃ, te ca me dhammā eta'r'ahi pavattino, ye ca me, bhante, dhammā pubbe manussabhūtassa nappavattino ahesuṃ, te ca me dhammā eta'r'ahi pavattino.

35753.grammar: pr, from na pavedhati, neg, intrans (+instr)
35753.meaning1: is not upset (by); is not stressed (about)
35753.construction:
na + pa + vedha + ti
na + pavedhati

examples.text: nindāya nappavedheyya, na uṇṇameyya pasaṃsito bhikkhu, lobhaṃ saha macchariyena, kodhaṃ pesuṇiyañ'ca panudeyya.

35754.grammar: pr, caus of na pavedhati, neg, trans (+acc)
35754.meaning1: does not shake; does not disturb; does not stir
35754.construction:
na + pa + vedhe + ti
na + pavedheti

examples.text: selo yathā ekagghano, vātena na samīrati, evaṃ rūpā rasā saddā, gandhā phassā ca kevalā, iṭṭhā dhammā aniṭṭhā ca, nappavedhenti tādino.

35755.grammar: pr, caus of na pavisati, neg, trans (+acc)
35755.meaning1: does not provide; does not furnish; does not supply (with)
35755.meaningLit: does not cause to enter forward
35755.construction:
na + pa + vese + ti
na + paveseti

35756.grammar: ger of na pajahati, neg, trans (+acc)
35756.meaning1: not leaving behind; not giving up; not abandoning

examples.text: chinda sotaṃ parakkamma, kāme panuda brāhmaṇa, nappahāya munī kāme, n'ekattam'upapajjati.

35757.meaning1: not abandoned; not dispelled; not eliminated; not removed; not given up

examples.text: sace, ānanda, bhikkhu paccavekkhamāno evaṃ pajānāti, atthi kho me imesu pañcasu kāmaguṇesu aññatarasmiṃ vā aññatarasmiṃ vā āyatane uppajjati cetaso samudācāro'ti, evaṃ santam'etaṃ, ānanda, bhikkhu evaṃ pajānāti, yo kho imesu pañcasu kāmaguṇesu chandarāgo so me nappahīno'ti.

35758.grammar: pr, from na pahoti, neg, intrans (+inf or +dat)
35758.construction:
na + pa + ho + ti
na + pahoti

examples.text: seyyathā'pi bhikkhave orabbhiko vā urabbhaghātako vā app'ekaccaṃ urabbhaṃ adinnaṃ ādiyamānaṃ… nappahoti hantuṃ vā bandhituṃ vā jāpetuṃ vā yathāpaccayaṃ vā kātuṃ.

dasa'pi, bhante, purisā, vīsam'pi, bhante, purisā, tiṃsam'pi, bhante, purisā, cattārīsam'pi, bhante, purisā, paññāsam'pi, bhante, purisā nappahonti yāvatikā imissā nāḷandāya pāṇā te ekena khaṇena ekena muhuttena ekaṃ maṃsakhalaṃ ekaṃ maṃsapuñjaṃ kātuṃ.

35759.grammar: pr, from na pahoti, neg, intrans
35759.meaning1: is not sufficient; is not enough (for)
35759.construction:
na + pa + ho + ti
na + pahoti

examples.text: no c'assa pāripūrī'ti kayiramānaṃ nappahoti.
ye pana te kulaputtā… sāmaññe apekkhavanto sikkhāya tibbagāravā nabāhulikā nasāthalikā okkamane nikkhittadhurā paviveke pubbaṅ'gamā… tehi bhavaṃ gotamo saddhiṃ saṃvasati.

35764.meaning1: not one's sister before; not previously one's sister
35764.commentary: (SNa) tesu imasmiṃ cakkavāḷe mātugāmakāle mātubhūtaññ'eva dassento yo namātābhūtapubbo'ti āha. yo napitābhūtapubbo'ti-ādīsu'pi es'eva nayo.

examples.text: na so, bhikkhave, satto sulabharūpo yo nabhaginibhūtapubbo … alaṃ vimuccitun'ti.

35765.notes: Mano-group nouns, while neuter in Sanskrit, are considered to be masculine by classical Pāḷi grammars such as Saddanīti. The example given is mano anicco, mano dukkho'ti. Counter-examples are amoghaṃ tapo and paramaṃ tapo.

examples.text: seyyathā'pi, bhikkhave, saradasamaye viddhe vigatavalāhake deve ādicco nabhaṃ abbhussakkamāno sabbaṃ ākāsagataṃ tamagataṃ abhivihacca bhāsate ca tapate ca virocati ca

35767.grammar: masc, abl sg of nabha, mano group
35767.notes: Mano-group nouns, while neuter in Sanskrit, are considered to be masculine by classical Pāḷi grammars such as Saddanīti. The example given is mano anicco, mano dukkho'ti. Counter-examples are amoghaṃ tapo and paramaṃ tapo.

35768.meaning1: not one's brother before; not previously one's brother
35768.commentary: (SNa) tesu imasmiṃ cakkavāḷe mātugāmakāle mātubhūtaññ'eva dassento yo namātābhūtapubbo'ti āha. yo napitābhūtapubbo'ti-ādīsu'pi es'eva nayo.

examples.text: sāvatthiyaṃ viharati … na so, bhikkhave, satto sulabharūpo yo nabhātābhūtapubbo … alaṃ vimuccitun'ti.

35769.meaning2: does not welcome; does not greet respectfully; does not say hello
35769.construction:
na + abhi + vada + ti
na + abhivadati

examples.text: tañ'ce bhikkhu n'ābhinandati n'ābhivadati n'ājjhosāya tiṭṭhati, tassa taṃ anabhinandato anabhivadato anajjhosāya tiṭṭhato nirujjhati nandī. nandinirodhā dukkhanirodho, puṇṇā'ti vadāmi

35770.meaning1: not intending to cause discord; with no desire for dissension; not wishing to break apart
35770.commentary: (VINa) bhed'ādhippāyassa vā'ti evam'ayaṃ etena saddhiṃ bhijjissatī'ti parassa parena bhedaṃ icchantassa vā.

examples.text: anāpatti napiyakamyassa, nabhed'ādhippāyassa, ummattakassa, ādikammikassā'ti.

35771.meaning2: action of homage; act of veneration; homage-paying

examples.text: kāmavitakkaṃ ce, bhikkhave, bhikkhu bahulam'anuvitakketi anuvicāreti, pahāsi nekkhammavitakkaṃ, kāmavitakkaṃ bahulam'akāsi, tassa taṃ kāmavitakkāya cittaṃ namati.
maraṇena'pi taṃ pahīyati, yaṃ puriso mam'idan'ti maññati, etam'pi viditvā paṇḍito, na mamattāya nametha māmako.

35775.meaning1: bows down; pays respect; worships (someone with)

examples.text: guṇehi yo sīlasamādhipaññā- vimuttiñāṇappabhutīhi yutto, khettaṃ janānaṃ kusal'atthikānaṃ, tam'ariyasaṅghaṃ sirasā namāmi.
tena kho pana samayena manussā khipanti vā upakkhalanti vā te evam'āhaṃsu, nam'atthu mahāgovindassa brāhmaṇassa, nam'atthu satta purohitassā'ti.
taṃ tvaṃ bhattaṃ paṭiggayha, brāhmaṇassa adāsayi, attānaṃ anasitvāna, ko'yaṃ dhammo nam'atthu te.
udakañ'hi nayanti nettikā, usukārā namayanti tejanaṃ, dāruṃ namayanti tacchakā, attānaṃ damayanti paṇḍitā.

35780.meaning1: not intending to kill; not aiming to murder

examples.text: anāpatti asañcicca ajānantassa namaraṇ'ādhippāyassa ummattakassa ādikammikassā'ti.

35781.notes: Mano-group nouns, while neuter in Sanskrit, are considered to be masculine by classical Pāḷi grammars such as Saddanīti. The example given is mano anicco, mano dukkho'ti. Counter-examples are amoghaṃ tapo and paramaṃ tapo.

examples.text: namo tassa bhagavato arahato sammāsambuddhassa

35782.synonym: apaciyati, pūjayati, pūjeti, maheti, māneti, saṃsevati
35782.commentary: (ANa) namassantī'ti kāyena namassanti, vācāya namassanti, manasā namassanti, dhamm'ānudhammapaṭipattiyā namassanti, sakkaronti garuṃ karonti.

examples.text: tasmā hi ne namasseyya, sakkareyya ca paṇḍito, annena atha pānena, vatthena sayanena ca.
no ce haritāni tiṇāni āmaseyyāsi, aggiṃ paricareyyāsi. no ce aggiṃ paricareyyāsi, pañjaliko ādiccaṃ namasseyyāsi
avañjhā pāricariyā, amoghā ca namassanā, dūrāgatam'pi maṃ santaṃ, khaṇoyaṃ na virādhayi.

35785.meaning2: should be worshipped; fit to be honoured

examples.text: icc'evam accanta-namassanīyaṃ namassamāno ratana-ttayaṃ yaṃ puññ'ābhisandaṃ vipulaṃ alatthaṃ, tass'ānubhāvena hat'antarāyo.

35786.synonym: garukaronta, namassamāna, pūjayanta, pūjayamāna, pūjenta, mānenta

examples.text: abhibhū hi so anabhibhūto, sakkhidhammam'anītiham'adassī, tasmā hi tassa bhagavato sāsane, appamatto sadā namassam'anusikkhe'ti.
idh'āgamā vijjupabhāsavaṇṇā, kokanadā pajjunnassa dhītā, buddhañ'ca dhammañ'ca namassamānā, gāthā'c'imā atthavatī abhāsi.
namassamāno aṭṭhāsiṃ, sattarattin'divaṃ ahaṃ, vuṭṭhahitvā samādhimhā, satthā loke anuttaro, mama kammaṃ pakittento, idaṃ vacanam'abravi.
nānārattehi vatthehi, sayaneh'āvasathehi ca, phītā janapadā raṭṭhā, te namassiṃsu brāhmaṇe.

35790.meaning1: should be worshipped; should be venerated; should be revered; should be honoured

examples.text: yathā kathaṃ pana, bhante, ariyassa vinaye cha disā namassitabbā? sādhu me, bhante, bhagavā tathā dhammaṃ desetu, yathā ariyassa vinaye cha disā namassitabbā'ti.
yadi n'atthi, pañcapatiṭṭhitaṃ katvā vanditabbā. tasmiṃ asampajjamāne añjaliṃ paggahetvā namassitabbā, tasmim'pi asampajjamāne pasannacittena piyacakkhūhi sampassitabbā.

35792.meaning1: having worshipped; having venerated; having revered; having honoured

examples.text: idaṃ vatvāna maghavā, devarājā sujampati, puthuddisā namassitvā, pamukho ratham'āruhī'ti.
sambodhiṃ buddhaseṭṭhānaṃ, sasaṅghe lokanāyake, dasaṅgulī namassitvā, sirasā abhivādayiṃ.

35794.meaning1: not one's mother before; not previously one's mother
35794.commentary: (SNa) tesu imasmiṃ cakkavāḷe mātugāmakāle mātubhūtaññ'eva dassento yo namātābhūtapubbo'ti āha.

examples.text: anamataggo'yaṃ, bhikkhave, saṃsāro … na so, bhikkhave, satto sulabharūpo yo namātābhūtapubbo iminā dīghena addhunā. taṃ kissa hetu?
itiha, bhikkhave, vipassissa bhagavato arahato sammāsambuddhassa paṭisañcikkhato app'ossukkatāya cittaṃ nami, no dhammadesanāya.

35797.meaning2: should be bent, should be bowed down

examples.text: ye keci rūpā idha vā huraṃ vā, ye c'antalikkhasmiṃ pabhāsavaṇṇā, sabb'eva te te namucippasatthā, āmisaṃ'va macchānaṃ vadhāya khittā'ti.
